name: Pleasing Man
overview: Scripture warns against the fear of man, describing it as a snare, and instead calls believers to place their trust fully in the Lord for true safety. Christians are exhorted to offer themselves as living sacrifices, seeking to please God rather than people, as seeking human approval compromises servanthood to Christ. Transformation through the renewing of the mind enables believers to discern and fulfill God's perfect will, while all actions should be done wholeheartedly as service to the Lord, not to men.
